pull.title: bip-0375: fix P2WPKH scriptPubKeys and signatures in test vectors
pull.body:
The P2WPKH inputs in BIP-375's test vectors cannot be spent by the keys they carry, and none of the 43 signatures in the vectors verifies. Each P2WPKH program is `SHA256(pubkey)[:20]` instead of `HASH160(pubkey)`. The test runner does not check signatures, so it does not catch this.

This PR sets each P2WPKH program to `HASH160(pubkey)` and makes the signatures again: BIP 143 for P2WPKH and P2SH-P2WPKH, legacy for P2PKH and the bare `OP_2` input of valid[0]. The vector for a non-`SIGHASH_ALL` signature had a `SIGHASH_ALL` signature; it now has a `SIGHASH_NONE` one, matching its `PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE`. The three signatures with no defined sighash, on the two segwit v2 inputs and in the vector without `PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT`, are removed; the one in the vector #2310 added has a commit of its own. The other 40 now verify, and the test runner's output is unchanged: 44 passed. #2317 makes the runner check the signatures. #2315 replaces the bare `OP_2` vector that this PR re-signs, so the two conflict there: whichever lands second drops that vector when it rebases. A separate commit sets Version 0.1.4 with its changelog entry: each of my open BIP-375 pull requests (#2315, #2316, #2317, #2324) does the same, and whichever lands first keeps 0.1.4 while the others rebase to the next version.

*Made with my usual tools: a computer, the Internet and an LLM. The mistakes, as usual, are all mine.*

bip-0375: fix P2WPKH scriptPubKeys and signatures in test vectors

The P2WPKH inputs of the test vectors spend a witness program equal to
SHA256(pubkey)[:20] instead of HASH160(pubkey), so the key each input
carries cannot spend it. None of the stored ECDSA signatures verifies
against the transaction its PSBT describes, whatever the input type. The
reference validator does not check signatures, so no test fails.

Set every P2WPKH witness program to HASH160 of the input's public key,
in PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO and in the supplementary witness_utxo and
prevout_scriptpubkey. Re-sign the PSBT_IN_PARTIAL_SIG signatures
deterministically (RFC 6979, low S): BIP 143 for P2WPKH and P2SH-P2WPKH,
the legacy signature hash for P2PKH and for the bare OP_2 input. Where
an input sets PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE, its signature uses that type, as BIP
174 requires.

Two vectors carried a signature with no defined signature hash: one on
a segwit v2 input, one in the vector whose output lacks PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT.
Remove both signatures, and mark the segwit v2 input as not signed in
the supplementary material. Both vectors still fail for their stated
reason.

Inside the PSBTs only PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO and PSBT_IN_PARTIAL_SIG
change, and the test runner's result for every vector is unchanged.

the same signature from the other segwit v2 vector. The validator still
rejects the input for its segwit version.
